{'text': '德語黑色喜劇《Where’s Wanda?》重返 Apple TV，第二季首集現已開播。以下是相關詳情。', 'paragraph_context': 'German-language dark comedy “Where’s Wanda?” is back on Apple TV, with the first episode of its second season now streaming. Here are the details.'}

{'text': '《Where’s Wanda?》第二季首集現已可供串流觀看', 'paragraph_context': '‘Where’s Wanda?’ season 2 premiere now available to stream'}

{'text': 'Apple TV 於 7 月公布《Where’s Wanda?》回歸，並在數周前發布預告後，如今已讓第二季首集正式開播。', 'paragraph_context': 'After announcing the return of “Where’s Wanda?” in July and releasing a trailer just a couple of weeks ago, Apple TV has now premiered the first episode of season 2.'}

{'text': '今晚首播適逢首季於 2024 年 11 月 13 日完結近兩年。Apple TV 在翌年 2 月為劇集續訂第二季，直到 2026 年 7 月才公布回歸日期。', 'paragraph_context': 'Tonight’s premiere comes nearly two years after the first season ended on November 13, 2024. Apple TV renewed the series for a second season the following February, but it wasn’t until July 2026 that the company announced its return date.'}

{'text': '《Where’s Wanda?》講述 Klatt 一家尋找失蹤女兒的故事。當他們對當地警方處理調查的方式感到越來越不滿，便決定自行處理，並在過程中揭開鄰居們的黑暗秘密。', 'paragraph_context': '“Where’s Wanda?” follows the Klatt family as they search for their missing daughter. After growing frustrated with the local police’s handling of the investigation, they decide to take matters into their own hands, uncovering their neighbors’ dark secrets along the way.'}

{'text': '今晚首播後，《Where’s Wanda?》第二季餘下 7 集將於 12 月 9 日前每週陸續推出。', 'paragraph_context': 'Following tonight’s premiere, the remaining seven episodes of “Where’s Wanda?” season 2 will roll out weekly through December 9.'}

{'text': '以下是 Apple TV 對《Where’s Wanda?》第二季的期望：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s Apple TV on what to expect from the second season of “Where’s Wanda?”:'}

{'text': '第二季中，Klatts（Makatsch 和 Stein）回歸！就在他們以為生活終於恢復正常之際，女兒 Wanda（Drinda）卻被發現似乎當場被捉到站在一具屍體旁。她們必須竭盡所能證明她清白，並避免再次失去她；她們為尋找真正兇手而進行的調查，亦會帶領她們深入這座寧靜郊區小鎮的犯罪黑幕。但她們為保護家庭而展開的追尋，究竟能讓眾人脫離困境，最終還是把事情弄得更糟？而她們能否在一切太遲之前，查明那個不幸日子的真相？', 'paragraph_context': 'In season two, the Klatts (Makatsch and Stein) are back! Just as they thought their lives were finally returning to normal, their daughter, Wanda (Drinda), is caught seemingly red-handed standing over a dead body. They will need to do everything in their power to prove her innocence and avoid losing her again, as their investigation to find the real murderer takes them into the criminal underbelly of their sleepy suburban town. But will their quest to protect their family get them all out of trouble, or ultimately lead them further astray? And can they find out the truth of what happened on that fateful day before it’s too late?'}
